title: Item:Guild Renown Elixir
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ {{Top}} Your ability to function as part of a team has been enhanced, and you have a slightly heighten sense of how to use your skills for the betterment of your guild. You gain +% bonus to all earned guild renown. Guild Renown Elixirs increase the amount for [[guild renown]] earned killing monsters, looting chests, and completing and turning in [[saga]]s. Must be in a guild to earn Guild Renown. The effect lasts for 3 to 6 hours.
